_meta.name: calibration_set_v1
_meta.purpose: Self-check BEFORE running the 5,796-item queue. Score these with your adjusted prompt, compare to human_label, and only proceed once every metric lands inside the accept band in PREANNOTATION_ADJUSTMENT.md.
_meta.selection: stratified to match the model mix of the 5,796 production queue; seed 20260819
_meta.ground_truth: single-pass human annotation from the project annotation app. NOT double-reviewed (only 81 train items ever were) - treat as a calibration reference, not gold.
_meta.no_leakage: every item is inside train_manifest_v2 and OUTSIDE test_802, so calibrating on it cannot leak the benchmark
_meta.no_contamination: these 409 items are DISJOINT from the 5,796 production queue and are already labelled, so they are not part of any deliverable
